_note: Devyani reports one Ind AS 108 segment (food and beverages) with a geographic split (India, Thailand, rest of world; AR FY26 note 49) and, in its presentations, India and International (Thailand, Nigeria, Nepal) revenue, brand contribution, operating EBITDA (pre-Ind AS 116, after rent) and reported EBITDA (post-Ind AS 116, before rent). We model two parts. India = consolidated revenue less International (equals the geographic note; the presentation's India line is ~1% higher because inter-company sales are eliminated only in the consolidated total). International = presentation figure (= Thailand + rest of world in the AR). India EBITDA = presentation India reported EBITDA; International EBITDA = consolidated less India. Thailand (Restaurants Development Co.) consolidated from 17-Jan-2024; Sky Gate (Biryani By Kilo) from 10-Jun-2025.
